mainEntity.name: What AI image models are available on Higgsfield?

acceptedAnswer.text: Higgsfield gives you access to 15+ leading models in one workspace, including Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image, Seedream, FLUX, Kling O1, and Higgsfield Soul. You can switch between models instantly and compare outputs to find the best fit for your project.

mainEntity.name: What is the maximum image resolution I can generate?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can generate images at up to 8K resolution natively. No upscaling required. Nano Banana Pro and Seedream both support native 4K output straight from the prompt.

mainEntity.name: Can Higgsfield generate accurate text inside images?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Nano Banana Pro is built on a reasoning engine that understands spelling, layout, and typography. It renders legible headlines, labels, and packaging text in multiple languages, a problem most AI image generators still struggle with.

mainEntity.name: Can I keep the same character consistent across multiple images?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Soul ID helps maintain a recognizable character across generations, even when changing outfits, settings, or styles. Whether you're building a campaign, a storyboard, or a lookbook, the same person appears in every frame without drift.

mainEntity.name: Can I turn my AI images into video?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can turn AI-generated images into videos using supported models such as Kling and Seedance. Upload your image, describe the movement you want, and adjust the available settings to generate your video.

mainEntity.name: What aspect ratios and formats are supported?

acceptedAnswer.text: Higgsfield supports all standard formats, including 1:1, 9:16, 16:9, 3:4, 4:3, and more. You can generate platform-ready visuals for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and print from the same workspace.

mainEntity.name: Can I edit specific parts of a generated image without regenerating the whole thing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Nano Banana Pro Inpaint lets you brush over any area and change it. You can swap objects, fix backgrounds, rewrite text, and adjust colors. The edit blends seamlessly with the rest of the image.
Yes. New users receive 10 free credits as a one-time welcome bonus to try image generation. Paid plans offer additional credits and access to more features.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Higgsfield with my team?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Higgsfield’s Team Plan lets your team work in a shared workspace. Credits contributed by each seat are pooled into one shared workspace balance, rather than assigned separately to individual members.

mainEntity.name: Can I input my exact brand colors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Nano Banana Pro lets you input Hex or RGB color codes directly to ensure every generation matches your brand guidelines, including backgrounds, text, and design elements, so everything stays on-brand from the first output.

Can I keep the same character consistent across multiple images?
Yes. Soul ID helps maintain a recognizable character across generations, even when changing outfits, settings, or styles. Whether you're building a campaign, a storyboard, or a lookbook, the same person appears in every frame without drift.

Higgsfield supports all standard formats, including 1:1, 9:16, 16:9, 3:4, 4:3, and more. You can generate platform-ready visuals for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and print from the same workspace.

Yes. Nano Banana Pro Inpaint lets you brush over any area and change it. You can swap objects, fix backgrounds, rewrite text, and adjust colors. The edit blends seamlessly with the rest of the image.

Yes. New users receive 10 free credits as a one-time welcome bonus to try image generation. Paid plans offer additional credits and access to more features.
Can I use Higgsfield with my team?
Yes. Higgsfield’s Team Plan lets your team work in a shared workspace. Credits contributed by each seat are pooled into one shared workspace balance, rather than assigned separately to individual members.
Can I input my exact brand colors?
Yes. Nano Banana Pro lets you input Hex or RGB color codes directly to ensure every generation matches your brand guidelines, including backgrounds, text, and design elements, so everything stays on-brand from the first output.
